import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static String[] g = new String[N];
    static int[][] n_scientists = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] n_rescue = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] infect_time = new int[N][N];
    static int[] di = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dj = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][][] reach_time = new int[N][N][N][N];

    static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev, cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }
        List<List<Edge>> g;
        int[] level, iter;
        Dinic(int n) {
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            iter = new int[n];
        }
        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            g.get(from).add(new Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap));
            g.get(to).add(new Edge(from, g.get(from).size() - 1, 0));
        }
        void bfs(int s) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(v)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int dfs(int v, int t, int f) {
            if (v == t) return f;
            for (; iter[v] < g.get(v).size(); iter[v]++) {
                Edge e = g.get(v).get(iter[v]);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == level[v] + 1) {
                    int ret = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (ret > 0) {
                        e.cap -= ret;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += ret;
                        return ret;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }
        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                bfs(s);
                if (level[t] == -1) break;
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                int f;
                while ((f = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) flow += f;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int nodeId(int n, int i, int j, boolean right) {
        return i * n + j + (right ? n * n : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        int[] explode = new int[2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    g[i] = "Y";
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    g[i] = "Z";
                    explode[0] = i;
                    explode[1] = j;
                } else {
                    g[i] = ".";
                    n_scientists[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = line.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    n_rescue[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) Arrays.fill(infect_time[i], -1);
        infect_time[explode[0]][explode[1]] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{explode[0], explode[1]});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int i = cur[0], j = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = i + di[d], nj = j + dj[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && g[ni].charAt(0) == '.' && infect_time[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    infect_time[ni][nj] = infect_time[i][j] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) Arrays.fill(reach_time[i][j][k], -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (g[i].charAt(0) == '.') {
                    reach_time[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                    Queue<int[]> queue = new LinkedList<>();
                    queue.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cur = queue.poll();
                        int ii = cur[0], jj = cur[1];
                        if (infect_time[ii][jj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] < infect_time[ii][jj]) {
                            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                                int ni = ii + di[d], nj = jj + dj[d];
                                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n && g[ni].charAt(0) == '.'
                                    && (infect_time[ni][nj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1 <= infect_time[ni][nj])
                                    && reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] == -1) {
                                    reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] = reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1;
                                    queue.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int src = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = src + 1;
        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(2 * n * n + 2);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (n_scientists[i][j] != 0) {
                    dinic.addEdge(src, nodeId(n, i, j, false), n_scientists[i][j]);
                }
                if (n_rescue[i][j] != 0) {
                    dinic.addEdge(nodeId(n, i, j, true), sink, n_rescue[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ii++) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < n; jj++) {
                        if (0 <= reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] && reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] <= t) {
                            dinic.addEdge(nodeId(n, i, j, false), nodeId(n, ii, jj, true), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow(src, sink));
    }
}
